description.value: Castella Cheesecake is a Japanese-style pastry bakery established in 2018, known for hand-crafted Basque burnt cheesecake, soufflé cheesecake, and molten cheese tarts made without heavy machinery. The YVR McArthurGlen Designer Outlet location is one of several storefronts the brand operates across Metro Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, and Alberta. Every product is made by a team of pastry specialists following home-baking methods championed by founder Billy.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Castella Cheesecake operates the YVR McArthurGlen Outlet Store at 7899 Templeton Station Rd, Richmond, matching the OSM address exactly. The site is active (copyright 2026) and lists this location among its current storefronts, supporting confirmed_open=true. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so all such fields are null.
